}}'''Kayserispor Kulübü''', commonly known as '''[[Kayserispor]]''', is a Turkish professional football club based in the city of [[Kayseri]]. Founded on 1 July 1966, the club currently competes in the [[TFF 1. Lig]], the second tier of Turkish football. Kayserispor plays its home matches at the [[Kadir Has Stadium]], which has a capacity of 31,856 all-seated spectators.<ref>{{cite web |title=RHG Enertürk Enerji Kayseri Stadyumu |url=https://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageID=394&stadID=39 |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=[[Turkish Football Federation]]}}</ref> The club's official colours are [[Red (colour)|red]] and [[yellow]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Kayserispor Kurumsal Kimlik Rehberi |url=https://kayserispor.org.tr/kurumsal-kimlik/ |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=[[Kayserispor]] |language=tr}}</ref>

Kayserispor has enjoyed domestic and international success over its history. The club won its first major trophy by claiming the [[Turkish Cup]] in 2008, defeating [[Gençlerbirliği]] in the final on penalties.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Türkiye Kupası Finali |url=https://www.uefa.com/insideuefa/news/01cc-0f84c52cfb6e-557b98e4f3e6-1000--kayserispor-win-turkish-cup/ |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=UEFA.com}}</ref> That same year, they also finished as runners-up in the [[Turkish Super Cup]]. The team's best league finishes have been fifth place in four separate seasons: [[2005–06 Süper Lig|2005–06]], [[2006–07 Süper Lig|2006–07]], [[2007–08 Süper Lig|2007–08]], and [[2012–13 Süper Lig|2012–13]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Kayserispor Sezon Performansları |url=https://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageID=395&kulupID=72 |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=[[Turkish Football Federation]]}}</ref>

Kayserispor made its European debut in the [[2006 UEFA Intertoto Cup]], and became one of the eleven co-winners, which granted them a spot in the [[2006–07 UEFA Cup|UEFA Cup]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Intertoto 2006: Kayserispor joint-winner |url=https://www.uefa.com/news-media/news/01b9-0e6c3e58a1f6-d52ce59c321a-1000--eleven-make-it-through-via-intertoto/ |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=UEFA.com}}</ref> Their most notable European fixtures included ties against [[AZ Alkmaar]] in 2006 and [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] in [[2008–09 UEFA Cup|2008]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Kayserispor 1–1 AZ |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/match/84874--kayserispor-vs-az-alkmaar/ |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=UEFA.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Kayserispor 1–2 PSG |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/match/303919--kayserispor-vs-paris/ |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=UEFA.com}}</ref>"}}
